items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: That thing that I did with Milt Hinton was called "Barrelhouse Blues and Boogie Woogie." That was the name of that album. With Vic Dickenson, Cozy Cole, Pete Brown and Jonah Jones.

ctx.x: Pete Brown and Vic Dickenson and...who was the drummer? Cole.
